As a Data Analyst & BI Specialist , you will play a key role in transforming raw data into business clarity, performance visibility, and actionable insights across our organization. Sitting at the intersection of data analytics, business intelligence, and reporting architecture, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to monitor business performance, analyze complex datasets, build clear dashboards, and help drive efficient growth.
 Key Responsibilities & Tasks: 
 1. Business Intelligence & Dashboarding 
Design, build, and maintain operational and executive dashboards in tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Looker Studio to track business-critical KPIs.
Process, organize, and transform complex datasets to support acquisition, affiliate, lifecycle, and overall business performance analysis.
Automate recurring reporting processes and help enforce unified metric standards across departments.
 2. Data Pipeline, Modeling & Architecture Support 
Write efficient queries and perform data transformation using SQL and cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery).
Assist in maintaining and optimizing data schemas, database structures, and ETL workflows from various data sources (GA4, ad networks, affiliate platforms, CRM).
Perform regular data cleaning, maintaining databases and data systems to ensure high data integrity, accurate KPI calculations, and compliance with data privacy regulations.
 3. Analytics, Funnel Analysis & Reporting Accuracy 
Analyze acquisition funnels, cohort behavior, Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), churn rates, and campaign profitability (CAC/CPA, ROAS/ROI).
Conduct reconciliation across marketing channels, affiliate platforms, and analytics data to address attribution or conversion discrepancies.
Deliver recurring analytical support through routine anomaly detection, weekly performance summaries, and monthly review reports.
 4. AI-Driven Efficiency & Insights (Nice to Have) 
Leverage AI tools to draft structured insight summaries and decision-ready narratives for stakeholders.
Use AI-assisted workflows to support anomaly detection, data quality checks, schema optimization, and recurring forecasting tasks.
Stay up-to-date with emerging tools and methodologies in AI-assisted analytics and cloud BI.
 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication 
Work closely with cross-functional teams (Performance Marketing, PM, CRM, Affiliate) to identify trends, solve analytical problems, and address business priorities.
Translate data findings into clear, concise reports and visualizations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Qualifications & Requirements 
 Experience: 2–4 years of proven working experience as a Data Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or BI Specialist (experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, performance marketing, or related sectors is a plus).
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Information Management, Statistics, or a related field.
 SQL & Data Warehousing: Solid command of SQL and experience querying relational databases and cloud data warehouses (such as BigQuery).
 BI & Visualization Tools: Proficiency with reporting and visualization platforms (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau).
 Web Analytics & Tracking: Knowledge of GA4 setup, funnel tracking, and familiarity with tracking tools (GTM, Keitaro performance marketing tool, or similar ad-tracking tools).
 Statistical & Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of statistics, data modeling, segmentation techniques, and core business metrics (LTV, CAC, ROAS, Retention). Familiarity with Python, R, or statistical packages (Excel, SPSS, SAS) is a plus.
 AI Tool Integration: Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools for code efficiency, reporting automation, and insight drafting.
 Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on detail, accuracy, and structured problem-solving.
